content.about: Armenia is a small, mountainous, landlocked country in the South Caucasus. It has one of the oldest Christian traditions in the world, with stone monasteries perched on cliffs. Mount Ararat, a symbol of the nation, is visible from its capital, Yerevan. Apricots and lavash flatbread are part of its identity.

standout.text: Armenia became the first country to adopt Christianity as its state religion, in 301.

didYouKnow: The Armenian alphabet was created around 405 by Mesrop Mashtots.
The world's oldest known leather shoe, about 5,500 years old, was found in an Armenian cave.
Yerevan is one of the oldest continuously inhabited cities in the world.
